value.rationale: Global optimization over all temporal couplings with fixed uniform marginals is stronger than comparison of common sampling policies. Sharp one-parameter optimal law and full equality characterization expose the exact freedom in choosing equitable short schedules. The natural four-node path gossip example gives a significant exact 49/94 reduction compared with independent scheduling, with clear scope limitations.
